items.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
items.title_cn: 训练编译：将自然语言规范转化为局部神经功能
items.summary: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider. items.summary: Language-model judges now gate training data, score generations, and drive leaderboards. The judge is then a measurement instrument, resting on one rarely stated assumption: the same request, sent to the same model name, reads the same tomorrow. We audited that assumption in two preregistered campai...

items.title: ESPO: Error-Structured Prompt Optimization via Diagnose, Diversify, and Stabilize
items.title_cn: ESPO ：通过诊断、多样化和稳定的错误结构化提示优化
items.summary: Evolutionary prompt optimizers such as GEPA suffer from prompt bloat: each iteration appends rules and caveats, producing prompts up to 3$\times$ longer yet no more accurate. We trace this to three deficiencies - incomplete error observation, limited search diversity, and unreliable selection - and ...
items.summary_cn: 进化提示优化器（如GEPA ）会出现提示臃肿：每次迭代都会附加规则和警告，产生的提示最多会延长3 $\ times $ ，但不会更准确。我们将其归因于三个缺陷-不完整的错误观察，有限的搜索多样性和不可靠的选择-以及...
